title: Give every thread its own element
hints: Look at the line that sets i. Block 0 gets the right elements. Which elements does block 1 get?
Block b starts where the blocks before it end. Each of them covers size elements.
explain: A thread is told two numbers, its block and its place in the block. Block b starts at element size * b, so thread t of block b handles element size * b + t. With t alone, every block handles the first size elements again and the rest are never written.
